purpose: 给 A3S agent 的命令行能力上下文；agent 可以按任务需要多轮使用当前环境中的任意本地 CLI 工具，但工具使用必须围绕假设和证据闭环，而不是脚本式全量扫描。

cli_tool_policy.allowed: 可以使用当前环境中的任意命令行工具，不预设命令类型白名单。
cli_tool_policy.selection: 由 agent 根据当前阶段、目标形态、候选假设和环境可达性自主选择命令；工具类别只是启发，不是必须逐项执行的清单。
cli_tool_policy.recording: 所有实际运行过的命令都必须写入 tool_runs，包含 command、cwd、预算/超时、退出码和关键证据。

provisioning_policy.description: 平台不向 agent 展开固定工具清单；agent 自行按目标形态选择本地命令。

adaptive_tool_use.principle: 工具由 agent 智能选择，用来回答当前假设问题、缩小不确定性或收集确认/驳回证据；不要把可用工具简单顺序调用一遍。
workflow: 先写清楚当前要回答的问题或候选假设。
选择最小、最相关、可限时且可清理的工具或命令组合。
解释为什么选择该工具，以及为什么不需要更重的扫描。
运行后提炼关键输出，判断它支持、削弱还是改变原假设。
根据结果决定继续深入、进入验证、驳回、降级或记录为证据不足。

tool_categories.use_when: 源码目标需要快速发现危险 API、权限边界、注入、反序列化、路径和加密误用线索。
存在 manifest、锁文件、容器镜像、第三方库或二进制依赖，需要判断依赖风险和版本暴露面。
候选或专长涉及默认凭据、证书、token、配置权限、TLS/加密默认值或敏感路径。
无源码/二进制目标需要文件类型、架构、动态依赖、符号、字符串、RPATH/RUNPATH 或 hardening 证据。
验证阶段需要崩溃、core、栈、越界诊断、运行行为、权限检查点或覆盖反馈。
环境已提供输入入口和隔离策略，候选需要短预算随机输入、协议/SQL/文件格式输入或 corpus 反馈。
目标暴露本地服务、HTTP/RPC/TLS/数据库协议、容器/IaC/部署配置或管理面。
目标是已授权 HTTP(S) 站点、管理面或 API，需要非破坏性确认 TLS、响应头、Cookie、CORS、技术指纹、敏感暴露和安全扫描器线索。
tool_categories.constraints: 仅限授权 origin 的低强度只读探测；禁止目录爆破、参数 fuzz、撞库、主动漏洞利用、资源耗尽、深度爬取和写操作。

anti_patterns: 不要因为某个 scanner 可用就无差别全量运行。
不要把 scanner 命中、CVE 命中或可疑字符串直接当作已确认漏洞。
不要把大量原始输出塞进报告；只保留能影响判断的证据。
不要扫描无关目录、第三方目标或超出授权范围的网络目标。
Web 站点工具只能在明确授权、限时限量和只读边界内使用；不要运行 intrusive、dos、fuzz、bruteforce 或 destructive 模板。
不要让候选发现无限延伸；有高价值候选时优先交给验证阶段。

agent_contract.role: agent builds or selects a bounded experiment environment and decides which local CLI commands are useful for the current target and candidate.
must_record: tool_strategy: question/hypothesis, selected tool class, reason, outcome, next decision
tool_runs: command, cwd, timeout/budget, exit code, key output tail
coverage_observations: what feedback was observed or why it was unavailable
crash_artifacts: crash input path, sanitizer/core/log path, stack summary when available
environment_setup: dependencies, sandbox/container, runtime arguments, logs/core/sanitizer/coverage settings and cleanup plan
limitations: why a tool was not run or why evidence remains inconclusive
safety: Only run commands against the local authorized workspace, artifact directory, temp directory, or explicitly configured local test target.
Use time, CPU, memory, corpus and output limits.
Prefer temporary harnesses and artifacts under /tmp or the configured artifact_root.
Do not operate on third-party targets or unrelated user directories.
For authorized web targets, use only bounded read-only HTTP/TLS checks unless the stage explicitly configures a local test environment.
Do not generate exploit deliverables or third-party attack payloads.

recommended_workflow: First decide whether the target is a source tree, single source file, binary, or no-source archive.
Prepare the smallest repeatable experiment environment before running invasive validation.

Choose tools by hypothesis: static/security scanners, SCA, secret scanners, binary metadata tools, dynamic diagnostics, fuzzers, protocol/API checks, web baseline tools, or infra scanners only when they answer the current question.
Inspect existing tests, fuzz targets, build scripts and corpus before inventing a harness.
Treat automated tool findings as leads until the agent has triaged reachability, impact and evidence quality.
For memory candidates, prefer sanitizer or existing fuzz harness evidence over static reasoning alone.
Use coverage feedback as a guide for the next agent decision, not as the sole success criterion.
If no coverage tool is available, report scenario/input coverage and missing observability explicitly.
